chapter: New Orleans bands, brass bands and learning bass
title: Johnny Brown and Johnny Dodds joining the band
summary: Johnny Brown's furniture wagon, Dodds working for him and being recruited to Ory's band; friendly, fight-prone evenings at the Eagle Saloon.
